name: Pentathlon
description: Pentathlon is a benchmark for holistic and realistic evaluation of model efficiency, focusing on inference efficiency with a strictly-controlled hardware platform and a suite of metrics including latency, throughput, memory overhead, and energy consumption. It is designed to mirror real-world application scenarios and facilitate fair and reproducible efficiency comparisons.
reputation: A recent benchmark for reproducible model efficiency comparison, especially for inference-time tradeoffs under controlled hardware.
notes: Focuses on inference efficiency evaluation with a standardized hardware platform and software library; initially for NLP but extensible.
